title: From Privileged Physics to Proprioceptive Control
question: With Humanoid-Gym's environment, rewards, command distribution and Isaac Gym → MuJoCo evaluation fixed, design how the policy uses privileged simulator state and proprioceptive history during training so that the gait transfers and survives pushes, an added payload and high-speed commands.
elab:
A humanoid trainer can see simulator state that its deployed policy cannot. The task uses privileged information and motion history to learn a proprioceptive gait that survives transfer to MuJoCo, unseen pushes, payload and fast commands.

Legged and humanoid sim-to-real is a research line with a decade of answers that all modify the same thing: how the policy is trained around a fixed environment, reward and evaluation so that it copes with the gap between the simulator it learns in and the world it runs in. Humanoid-Gym's stock PPO already gives the critic privileged simulator state (the asymmetric actor-critic of Pinto et al., 2017); RMA adds an adaptation module that recovers environment extrinsics from proprioceptive history (Kumar et al., 2021); DreamWaQ and the Hybrid Internal Model estimate body velocity and a latent context from that history (Nahrendra et al., 2023; Long et al., 2024). The task fixes the Humanoid-Gym pipeline and evaluates each policy after transfer from Isaac Gym to MuJoCo — the paper's own sim-to-sim proxy for sim-to-real — under the robustness tests this line of work reports: random pushes stronger than the training randomisation (scored on survival, as in DreamWaQ), a payload beyond the training mass range (as in RMA and HIM), and velocity commands faster than the training distribution. It matters because the transfer step is the one every real-robot deployment passes through, and the training-side design is what decides it.
readme_methods_line: Asymmetric actor-critic (Gu et al., 2024; Pinto et al., 2017); Symmetric critic (Pinto et al., 2017, ablation); RMA-style adaptation (Kumar et al., 2021); DreamWaQ-style estimator (Nahrendra et al., 2023); HIM-style estimator (Long et al., 2024).
description_md:
# Humanoid Sim-to-Real Policy Learning: Privileged Information and Context Estimation

## Objective
Improve how a humanoid locomotion policy is *trained* so that it survives the transfer out of the simulator it was trained in. The environment, its rewards, its domain randomisation, the training command distribution and the evaluation are all fixed; you change the policy-learning algorithm.

**What is evaluated.** Policies are trained in Isaac Gym and evaluated in MuJoCo. This is the sim-to-sim stage of Humanoid-Gym's zero-shot sim-to-real pipeline (Gu et al., 2024, arXiv:2404.05695): the paper trains in Isaac Gym, verifies the policy in MuJoCo, whose dynamics it calibrated to sit closer to the real robot, and only then deploys on the physical XBot-L. This task runs the first two stages; no physical robot is evaluated. The transfer gap the policy has to survive is the Isaac Gym → MuJoCo gap, evaluated under the robustness protocols this line of work reports for its deployed policies: external pushes stronger than the training randomisation (DreamWaQ's push-recovery test), a payload beyond the training mass randomisation (RMA's and HIM's payload tests), and velocity commands beyond the training distribution.

## Research Question
**How should a legged-locomotion policy use privileged simulator information and the history of its own proprioception during training so that the deployed, proprioception-only policy transfers across the dynamics gap?**

This is the question the legged sim-to-real RL line has been working on for a decade, and the published answers all modify the same thing — the policy-learning algorithm around a fixed environment, reward and evaluation:

- **Asymmetric actor-critic** (Pinto et al., 2017, arXiv:1710.06542; Rudin et al., 2022, arXiv:2109.11978): the critic is trained on the full simulator state while the actor only sees what the robot can sense. Humanoid-Gym's stock PPO is of this kind: a 3-frame stack of noise-free privileged state for the value function, a 15-frame stack of noisy proprioception for the policy.
- **Teacher–student adaptation** (RMA; Kumar et al., 2021, arXiv:2107.04034): a teacher policy is trained with a learned encoding of the privileged environment factors, then an adaptation module learns to infer that encoding from the proprioceptive history, so the deployed student needs no privileged input.
- **Context-aided estimation** (DreamWaQ; Nahrendra et al., 2023, arXiv:2301.10602): an estimator trained jointly with the policy predicts the body velocity and a latent context from proprioceptive history (a β-VAE that also reconstructs the next observation), and the policy consumes the estimates.
- **Hybrid internal models** (HIM; Long et al., 2024, arXiv:2312.11460): a velocity estimate plus an implicit latent trained contrastively against the robot's next observation, fed to the policy.

The methods differ in *what* the privileged state is used for (value function only; a regression target for an encoding; a supervision signal for an explicit estimate), *when* it is used (one phase or two) and *how the deployed policy sees its history* (raw frame stack vs. a learned latent). Your contribution is a new design on this axis — or a better one of these — implemented in the algorithm files below and measured by the fixed sim-to-sim evaluation.

## Background
The robot (RobotEra XBot-L, 12 actuated leg joints) tracks 3D velocity commands `(vx, vy, dyaw)`; the policy runs at 100 Hz and outputs target joint positions for a PD controller. The training and evaluation infrastructure is **Humanoid-Gym** (https://github.com/roboterax/humanoid-gym): Isaac Gym with 4096 parallel robots, domain randomisation (friction, base mass, random pushes, observation noise, action delay) and a periodic-gait reward, then a calibrated MuJoCo model of the same robot for transfer verification.

The algorithm is Humanoid-Gym's rsl_rl-style PPO, split into three files you edit:
1. **Actor-critic** (`actor_critic_custom.py`): the policy, the value function, any encoder / estimator / adaptation module, and the deployed policy module `self.actor`.
2. **PPO** (`ppo_custom.py`): the rollout interface (`act`, `process_env_step`, `compute_returns`) and the update (`update`), including any auxiliary or supervised objective and any phase schedule.
3. **Rollout storage** (`rollout_storage_custom.py`): what is stored per transition and how mini-batches are produced.

## Observation and deployment contract (fixed)
- **Actor observation** (what the policy and the deployed policy see): `15 × 47` floats, oldest frame first. One frame = [gait-phase sin/cos (2), commands vx vy dyaw (3), joint positions (12), joint velocities (12), previous action (12), base angular velocity (3), base euler angles (3)], with the simulator's observation noise added. The MuJoCo evaluation builds exactly this stack from its own sensors.
- **Critic (privileged) observation**: `3 × 73` floats, oldest frame first, noise-free. One frame = [phase+commands (5), joint pos (12), joint vel (12), previous action (12), joint pos − reference gait pos (12), base linear velocity (3), base angular velocity (3), base euler (3), push force xy (2), push torque (3), foot friction (1), base mass/30 (1), stance mask (2), contact mask (2)]. It exists only in simulation. Named slices for every field are defined in the read-only header of `actor_critic_custom.py`.
- **Deployed policy**: `ActorCritic.actor` must be a self-contained `nn.Module` mapping the 705-float actor observation to 12 actions. After training it is exported by tracing (`torch.jit.trace` on a `[1, 705]` input, checked against the eager module on random inputs), and the traced archive is the only thing the evaluation runs — so it must be a deterministic, traceable function of its input: no sampling, no Python-side state across calls, no data-dependent Python control flow. Anything that must run on the robot (an estimator, an adaptation module) has to be inside it; anything privileged cannot be.
- **Harness calls** (read-only `OnPolicyRunner`): per iteration, 60 × `act(obs, critic_obs)` under `torch.inference_mode()`, `process_env_step(rewards, dones, infos)` after each step, `compute_returns(last_critic_obs, last_obs)` once, then `update() -> (mean_value_loss, mean_surrogate_loss)`. The runner sets `alg.num_learning_iterations` (the total budget) before the first iteration. Rollouts continue across iterations without an environment reset. `ActorCritic(num_actor_obs, num_critic_obs, num_actions, actor_hidden_dims, critic_hidden_dims, init_noise_std, activation)` and `PPO(actor_critic, **algorithm_cfg, device=...)` are the constructor signatures the runner uses.

**Fixed**: environment, rewards, domain randomisation, training command distribution, PPO recipe (learning rate 1e-5, 2 epochs, 4 mini-batches, γ = 0.994, λ = 0.9, entropy 0.001, clip 0.2 — `humanoid_config_custom.py` is read-only), 4096 environments × 60 steps × the official XBot-L iteration budget, observation/action spaces, the MuJoCo evaluation.

## Parameter budget
Two caps, both 1.05 × the largest baseline, checked before every training run by `budget_check.py`: the **deployed** policy (`ActorCritic.actor`, everything that runs on the robot) and the **total** `ActorCritic` (critic, encoders, decoders, estimator targets included). A submission over either cap is not trained.

## Evaluation
Trained in Isaac Gym (4096 parallel envs, official XBot iteration budget), the exported policy is then run in MuJoCo (sim-to-sim transfer) on random 3D velocity commands `(vx, vy, dyaw)`, each for a 10-second episode, using Humanoid-Gym's own sim2sim control loop (1 kHz physics, 100 Hz policy, the XBot-L PD gains, the training environment's observation frame and scales).

**Success criterion** (per command):
- the robot does not fall (base height > 0.3 m, |roll|, |pitch| < 0.5 rad for the whole episode), and
- the average velocity-tracking error (linear-velocity norm error + |yaw-rate| error) stays below 0.5.

**Metrics** (emitted per evaluation regime):
- `success_rate`: fraction of commands meeting both criteria (higher is better; the scored metric of the payload and high-speed regimes)
- `avg_vel_error`: average velocity-tracking error over the commands (lower is better; reported, not scored)
- `fall_rate`: fraction of commands in which the robot fell (lower is better; the scored metric of the push-recovery regime, i.e. its survival rate 1 − `fall_rate`)

**Settings.** The evaluation is run under three regimes, each a separate setting, each stressing a different part of the transfer: (1) *push recovery* — mixed omnidirectional commands (forward/backward, lateral, turning) while the base is hit by random velocity pushes, applied the way the training environment applies its pushes but stronger and more frequent than the training randomisation; (2) *payload shift* — forward-dominant walking with an extra mass on the base beyond the training mass randomisation; (3) *high speed* — velocity commands faster than the training distribution. Push recovery is scored on survival (`fall_rate`, lower is better), since the pushes themselves knock the base off the commanded velocity; payload shift and high speed are scored on `success_rate`. The task score is the geometric mean over the three settings, so a policy has to transfer in every regime rather than on average. The command ranges, push magnitudes and payload are fixed by the evaluation harness.

## Reference Baselines
All arms share the environment, the PPO recipe, the actor width [512, 256, 128] and the privileged critic [768, 256, 128] (except where the method replaces it); they differ only in how privileged information and history are used.

- **`default`** — Humanoid-Gym stock PPO (Gu et al., 2024): asymmetric actor-critic; policy on the raw 15-frame proprioceptive stack, critic on the 3-frame privileged stack. The unmodified starting point.
- **`symmetric_critic`** — the symmetric-critic baseline (Pinto et al., 2017): identical, except the critic is conditioned on the policy's own observation and never sees privileged state.
- **`rma`** — Rapid Motor Adaptation (Kumar et al., 2021): phase 1 trains the policy on (current frame, z = μ(privileged environment factors)) jointly with the encoder μ; phase 2 (the paper's 1000/16000 share of the iteration budget) freezes them and regresses an adaptation module φ(history) → z on on-policy student rollouts; deployed policy = π ∘ φ.
- **`dreamwaq`** — DreamWaQ (Nahrendra et al., 2023): a context-aided estimator (β-VAE over the history: body-velocity head, 16-d latent, next-frame reconstruction) trained synchronously with PPO on the same rollouts with its own Adam optimizer; policy on (current frame, v̂, z) with adaptive bootstrapping of the velocity input; privileged critic.
- **`him`** — Hybrid Internal Model (Long et al., 2024): a history encoder producing a velocity estimate and a 16-d latent trained by a swapped prototype-assignment contrastive loss against a target network over the next observation, updated inside PPO's mini-batch loop; policy on (current frame, v̂, z); privileged critic.

## Hints
- The deployed policy can only ever see the 705-float proprioceptive stack: every use of privileged state has to be turned into something the policy can compute from that stack (a value function, a regression target, a latent), and the transfer gap decides which uses survive.
- Start from the arm closest to your idea; the arms are the published ways of spending the same fixed simulation budget on the same robot.
- `budget_check.py` is run before training; keep `ActorCritic.actor` self-contained and within budget, or the run is rejected before it starts.
- The export traces `ActorCritic.actor` and refuses a module whose trace does not reproduce it (sampling, Python-side state, input-dependent branching): a deployed policy is a deterministic function of the observation stack, exactly as on the robot.

instruction_harness.Your Workspace:
You are working inside `/workspace`. The package source tree
`/workspace/humanoid-gym/` is the research scaffold for this task.
instruction_harness.Files You May Edit:
You may **only** modify these files, and **only within the listed line ranges
(inclusive, 1-indexed)**.

Editing outside those ranges will score your submission zero, and so will
creating or deleting any file inside the task's own source trees
(`/workspace/humanoid-gym/`, and anything else that was already there when
you started). Files you write anywhere else — scratch space, caches,
checkpoints, `$OUTPUT_DIR`, `/tmp` — are not part of your submission, so use
them freely.

- `humanoid-gym/humanoid/algo/ppo/actor_critic_custom.py`
- editable lines **73–165**
- `humanoid-gym/humanoid/algo/ppo/ppo_custom.py`
- editable lines **50–196**
- `humanoid-gym/humanoid/algo/ppo/rollout_storage_custom.py`
- editable lines **34–181**


Other files you may **read** for context (do not modify):
- `humanoid-gym/humanoid/envs/custom/humanoid_config_custom.py`
- `humanoid-gym/humanoid/envs/custom/humanoid_config.py`
- `humanoid-gym/humanoid/envs/custom/humanoid_env.py`
- `humanoid-gym/humanoid/algo/ppo/on_policy_runner.py`
- `humanoid-gym/humanoid/algo/ppo/actor_critic.py`
- `humanoid-gym/humanoid/algo/ppo/ppo.py`
- `humanoid-gym/humanoid/algo/ppo/rollout_storage.py`
instruction_harness.How You Will Be Evaluated:
After you finish, evaluation runs a fixed set of scripts and aggregates the
metrics they emit into one score, the same way the leaderboard does. Those
scripts are **not** in your workspace: you cannot read or modify them.

Which settings you are scored on is deliberately **not** disclosed, and some
of them never run where you can see them. In Harbor you can re-run the
evaluation, so naming the settings and their budgets would turn this into a
targeting exercise; what is being measured is whether the change you submit
is a *general* improvement to the algorithm, not whether it was tuned to a
configuration you were handed.
instruction_harness.Parameter Budget: Keep your model's total parameter count at or below the strongest reference baseline's. A check runs automatically — you don't need to invoke it — and a materially larger model makes the run invalid. The contribution must be algorithmic, not extra capacity.
instruction_harness.Tips:
- Keep the function/class signatures of the editable regions identical;
  evaluation imports them by name.
- Determinism matters: seeds are fixed; don't introduce hidden randomness.
- The baseline implementations above are deliberately strong. Aim for an
  *algorithmic* improvement — many hyperparameters are locked outside the
  editable surface anyway.
instruction_harness.Time Budget:
You have **5 hours** of wall-clock time before submission, covering
everything you do here: reading the code, editing it, and any trial runs
you launch.

Good luck.

# actor obs   = FRAME_STACK x SINGLE_OBS_DIM = 705 floats, oldest frame first,
#               newest frame LAST (obs[:, -SINGLE_OBS_DIM:]). Each 47-float frame
#               is [gait phase sin/cos (2), velocity command vx vy dyaw (3),
#               joint pos q (12), joint vel dq (12), previous action (12), base
#               angular velocity (3), base euler xyz (3)] and carries the
#               simulator's observation noise. This is ALSO the exact input the
#               deployed policy receives in the MuJoCo evaluation.
# critic obs  = PRIV_FRAME_STACK x SINGLE_PRIV_DIM = 219 floats, oldest frame
#               first. Each 73-float privileged frame is noise-free:
#               [phase+command (5), q (12), dq (12), previous action (12),
#               q - q_ref (12), base linear velocity (3), base angular velocity
#               (3), base euler (3), push force xy (2), push torque (3), foot
#               friction (1), body mass/30 (1), stance mask (2), contact mask (2)].
#               Privileged state exists ONLY in simulation: the deployed policy
#               never sees it.
# Deployment contract: `self.actor` is exported by torch.jit.trace on a [1, 705]
# input and called as actor(obs_705) -> action_12 at 100 Hz in MuJoCo, so it must
# be a self-contained, deterministic, traceable nn.Module over the actor obs alone.
SINGLE_OBS_DIM = 47
FRAME_STACK = 15
SINGLE_PRIV_DIM = 73
PRIV_FRAME_STACK = 3
# Slices inside ONE privileged frame (offset by k * SINGLE_PRIV_DIM for frame k;
# the newest frame is the last one).
PRIV_PROPRIO = slice(0, 41)        # phase+command, q, dq, previous action (as in actor obs)
PRIV_Q_DIFF = slice(41, 53)        # q - reference gait q
PRIV_LIN_VEL = slice(53, 56)       # base linear velocity (scaled x2) -- not in actor obs
PRIV_ANG_VEL = slice(56, 59)
PRIV_EULER = slice(59, 62)
PRIV_PUSH_FORCE = slice(62, 64)    # random push velocity xy applied to the base
PRIV_PUSH_TORQUE = slice(64, 67)
PRIV_FRICTION = slice(67, 68)      # randomised foot friction
PRIV_MASS = slice(68, 69)          # randomised base mass / 30
PRIV_STANCE_MASK = slice(69, 71)
PRIV_CONTACT_MASK = slice(71, 73)

class ActorCritic(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self,  num_actor_obs,
                        num_critic_obs,
                        num_actions,
                        actor_hidden_dims=[256, 256, 256],
                        critic_hidden_dims=[256, 256, 256],
                        init_noise_std=1.0,
                        activation = nn.ELU(),
                        **kwargs):
        if kwargs:
            print("ActorCritic.__init__ got unexpected arguments, which will be ignored: " + str([key for key in kwargs.keys()]))
        super(ActorCritic, self).__init__()


        mlp_input_dim_a = num_actor_obs
        mlp_input_dim_c = num_critic_obs
        # Policy
        actor_layers = []
        actor_layers.append(nn.Linear(mlp_input_dim_a, actor_hidden_dims[0]))
        actor_layers.append(activation)
        for l in range(len(actor_hidden_dims)):
            if l == len(actor_hidden_dims) - 1:
                actor_layers.append(nn.Linear(actor_hidden_dims[l], num_actions))
            else:
                actor_layers.append(nn.Linear(actor_hidden_dims[l], actor_hidden_dims[l + 1]))
                actor_layers.append(activation)
        self.actor = nn.Sequential(*actor_layers)

        # Value function
        critic_layers = []
        critic_layers.append(nn.Linear(mlp_input_dim_c, critic_hidden_dims[0]))
        critic_layers.append(activation)
        for l in range(len(critic_hidden_dims)):
            if l == len(critic_hidden_dims) - 1:
                critic_layers.append(nn.Linear(critic_hidden_dims[l], 1))
            else:
                critic_layers.append(nn.Linear(critic_hidden_dims[l], critic_hidden_dims[l + 1]))
                critic_layers.append(activation)
        self.critic = nn.Sequential(*critic_layers)

        print(f"Actor MLP: {self.actor}")
        print(f"Critic MLP: {self.critic}")

        # Action noise
        self.std = nn.Parameter(init_noise_std * torch.ones(num_actions))
        self.distribution = None
        # disable args validation for speedup
        Normal.set_default_validate_args = False


    @staticmethod
    # not used at the moment
    def init_weights(sequential, scales):
        [torch.nn.init.orthogonal_(module.weight, gain=scales[idx]) for idx, module in
         enumerate(mod for mod in sequential if isinstance(mod, nn.Linear))]


    def reset(self, dones=None):
        pass

    def forward(self):
        raise NotImplementedError

    @property
    def action_mean(self):
        return self.distribution.mean

    @property
    def action_std(self):
        return self.distribution.stddev

    @property
    def entropy(self):
        return self.distribution.entropy().sum(dim=-1)

    def update_distribution(self, observations):
        mean = self.actor(observations)
        self.distribution = Normal(mean, mean*0. + self.std)

    def act(self, observations, **kwargs):
        self.update_distribution(observations)
        return self.distribution.sample()

    def get_actions_log_prob(self, actions):
        return self.distribution.log_prob(actions).sum(dim=-1)

    def act_inference(self, observations):
        actions_mean = self.actor(observations)
        return actions_mean

    def evaluate(self, critic_observations, **kwargs):
        value = self.critic(critic_observations)
        return value

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim

from .actor_critic_custom import ActorCritic
from .rollout_storage_custom import RolloutStorage

# Harness contract (OnPolicyRunner, read-only). Per iteration it calls
#   act(obs, critic_obs)                       once per env step (no grad)
#   process_env_step(rewards, dones, infos)    after every env step
#   compute_returns(last_critic_obs, last_obs) once, after the rollout
#   update() -> (mean_value_loss, mean_surrogate_loss)
# and it sets self.num_learning_iterations (the total iteration budget) before
# the first iteration. It reads self.actor_critic.std, self.learning_rate and
# self.optimizer (checkpoints). Rollouts continue across iterations without an
# environment reset, so the `obs` of the first act() of iteration i+1 is the
# successor of the last transition of iteration i.

class PPO:
    actor_critic: ActorCritic
    def __init__(self,
                 actor_critic,
                 num_learning_epochs=1,
                 num_mini_batches=1,
                 clip_param=0.2,
                 gamma=0.998,
                 lam=0.95,
                 value_loss_coef=1.0,
                 entropy_coef=0.0,
                 learning_rate=1e-3,
                 max_grad_norm=1.0,
                 use_clipped_value_loss=True,
                 schedule="fixed",
                 desired_kl=0.01,
                 device='cpu',
                 ):

        self.device = device

        self.desired_kl = desired_kl
        self.schedule = schedule
        self.learning_rate = learning_rate

        # PPO components
        self.actor_critic = actor_critic
        self.actor_critic.to(self.device)
        self.storage = None # initialized later
        self.optimizer = optim.Adam(self.actor_critic.parameters(), lr=learning_rate)
        self.transition = RolloutStorage.Transition()

        # PPO parameters
        self.clip_param = clip_param
        self.num_learning_epochs = num_learning_epochs
        self.num_mini_batches = num_mini_batches
        self.value_loss_coef = value_loss_coef
        self.entropy_coef = entropy_coef
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.lam = lam
        self.max_grad_norm = max_grad_norm
        self.use_clipped_value_loss = use_clipped_value_loss

    def init_storage(self, num_envs, num_transitions_per_env, actor_obs_shape, critic_obs_shape, action_shape):
        self.storage = RolloutStorage(num_envs, num_transitions_per_env, actor_obs_shape, critic_obs_shape, action_shape, self.device)

    def test_mode(self):
        self.actor_critic.eval()

    def train_mode(self):
        self.actor_critic.train()

    def act(self, obs, critic_obs):
        # Compute the actions and values. Both observation views are handed to
        # the actor-critic; the stock ActorCritic ignores the keyword extras.
        self.transition.actions = self.actor_critic.act(obs, critic_obs=critic_obs).detach()
        self.transition.values = self.actor_critic.evaluate(critic_obs, obs=obs).detach()
        self.transition.actions_log_prob = self.actor_critic.get_actions_log_prob(self.transition.actions).detach()
        self.transition.action_mean = self.actor_critic.action_mean.detach()
        self.transition.action_sigma = self.actor_critic.action_std.detach()
        # need to record obs and critic_obs before env.step()
        self.transition.observations = obs
        self.transition.critic_observations = critic_obs
        return self.transition.actions

    def process_env_step(self, rewards, dones, infos):
        self.transition.rewards = rewards.clone()
        self.transition.dones = dones
        # Bootstrapping on time outs
        if 'time_outs' in infos:
            self.transition.rewards += self.gamma * torch.squeeze(self.transition.values * infos['time_outs'].unsqueeze(1).to(self.device), 1)

        # Record the transition
        self.storage.add_transitions(self.transition)
        self.transition.clear()
        self.actor_critic.reset(dones)

    def compute_returns(self, last_critic_obs, last_obs=None):
        last_values = self.actor_critic.evaluate(last_critic_obs, obs=last_obs).detach()
        self.storage.compute_returns(last_values, self.gamma, self.lam)

    def update(self):
        mean_value_loss = 0
        mean_surrogate_loss = 0

        generator = self.storage.mini_batch_generator(self.num_mini_batches, self.num_learning_epochs)
        for obs_batch, critic_obs_batch, actions_batch, target_values_batch, advantages_batch, returns_batch, old_actions_log_prob_batch, \
            old_mu_batch, old_sigma_batch, hid_states_batch, masks_batch in generator:


                self.actor_critic.act(obs_batch, critic_obs=critic_obs_batch, masks=masks_batch, hidden_states=hid_states_batch[0])
                actions_log_prob_batch = self.actor_critic.get_actions_log_prob(actions_batch)
                value_batch = self.actor_critic.evaluate(critic_obs_batch, obs=obs_batch, masks=masks_batch, hidden_states=hid_states_batch[1])
                mu_batch = self.actor_critic.action_mean
                sigma_batch = self.actor_critic.action_std
                entropy_batch = self.actor_critic.entropy

                # KL
                if self.desired_kl != None and self.schedule == 'adaptive':
                    with torch.inference_mode():
                        kl = torch.sum(
                            torch.log(sigma_batch / old_sigma_batch + 1.e-5) + (torch.square(old_sigma_batch) + torch.square(old_mu_batch - mu_batch)) / (2.0 * torch.square(sigma_batch)) - 0.5, axis=-1)
                        kl_mean = torch.mean(kl)

                        if kl_mean > self.desired_kl * 2.0:
                            self.learning_rate = max(1e-5, self.learning_rate / 1.5)
                        elif kl_mean < self.desired_kl / 2.0 and kl_mean > 0.0:
                            self.learning_rate = min(1e-2, self.learning_rate * 1.5)

                        for param_group in self.optimizer.param_groups:
                            param_group['lr'] = self.learning_rate


                # Surrogate loss
                ratio = torch.exp(actions_log_prob_batch - torch.squeeze(old_actions_log_prob_batch))
                surrogate = -torch.squeeze(advantages_batch) * ratio
                surrogate_clipped = -torch.squeeze(advantages_batch) * torch.clamp(ratio, 1.0 - self.clip_param,
                                                                                1.0 + self.clip_param)
                surrogate_loss = torch.max(surrogate, surrogate_clipped).mean()

                # Value function loss
                if self.use_clipped_value_loss:
                    value_clipped = target_values_batch + (value_batch - target_values_batch).clamp(-self.clip_param,
                                                                                                    self.clip_param)
                    value_losses = (value_batch - returns_batch).pow(2)
                    value_losses_clipped = (value_clipped - returns_batch).pow(2)
                    value_loss = torch.max(value_losses, value_losses_clipped).mean()
                else:
                    value_loss = (returns_batch - value_batch).pow(2).mean()

                loss = surrogate_loss + self.value_loss_coef * value_loss - self.entropy_coef * entropy_batch.mean()

                # Gradient step
                self.optimizer.zero_grad()
                loss.backward()
                nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(self.actor_critic.parameters(), self.max_grad_norm)
                self.optimizer.step()

                mean_value_loss += value_loss.item()
                mean_surrogate_loss += surrogate_loss.item()

        num_updates = self.num_learning_epochs * self.num_mini_batches
        mean_value_loss /= num_updates
        mean_surrogate_loss /= num_updates
        self.storage.clear()

        return mean_value_loss, mean_surrogate_loss

import torch

class RolloutStorage:
    class Transition:
        def __init__(self):
            self.observations = None
            self.critic_observations = None
            self.actions = None
            self.rewards = None
            self.dones = None
            self.values = None
            self.actions_log_prob = None
            self.action_mean = None
            self.action_sigma = None
            self.hidden_states = None

        def clear(self):
            self.__init__()

    def __init__(self, num_envs, num_transitions_per_env, obs_shape, privileged_obs_shape, actions_shape, device='cpu'):

        self.device = device

        self.obs_shape = obs_shape
        self.privileged_obs_shape = privileged_obs_shape
        self.actions_shape = actions_shape

        # Core
        self.observations = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, *obs_shape, device=self.device)
        if privileged_obs_shape[0] is not None:
            self.privileged_observations = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, *privileged_obs_shape, device=self.device)
        else:
            self.privileged_observations = None
        self.rewards = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device)
        self.actions = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, *actions_shape, device=self.device)
        self.dones = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device).byte()

        # For PPO
        self.actions_log_prob = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device)
        self.values = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device)
        self.returns = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device)
        self.advantages = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device)
        self.mu = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, *actions_shape, device=self.device)
        self.sigma = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, *actions_shape, device=self.device)

        self.num_transitions_per_env = num_transitions_per_env
        self.num_envs = num_envs

        # rnn
        self.saved_hidden_states_a = None
        self.saved_hidden_states_c = None

        self.step = 0

    def add_transitions(self, transition: Transition):
        if self.step >= self.num_transitions_per_env:
            raise AssertionError("Rollout buffer overflow")
        self.observations[self.step].copy_(transition.observations)
        if self.privileged_observations is not None: self.privileged_observations[self.step].copy_(transition.critic_observations)
        self.actions[self.step].copy_(transition.actions)
        self.rewards[self.step].copy_(transition.rewards.view(-1, 1))
        self.dones[self.step].copy_(transition.dones.view(-1, 1))
        self.values[self.step].copy_(transition.values)
        self.actions_log_prob[self.step].copy_(transition.actions_log_prob.view(-1, 1))
        self.mu[self.step].copy_(transition.action_mean)
        self.sigma[self.step].copy_(transition.action_sigma)
        self._save_hidden_states(transition.hidden_states)
        self.step += 1

    def _save_hidden_states(self, hidden_states):
        if hidden_states is None or hidden_states==(None, None):
            return
        # make a tuple out of GRU hidden state to match the LSTM format
        hid_a = hidden_states[0] if isinstance(hidden_states[0], tuple) else (hidden_states[0],)
        hid_c = hidden_states[1] if isinstance(hidden_states[1], tuple) else (hidden_states[1],)

        # initialize if needed
        if self.saved_hidden_states_a is None:
            self.saved_hidden_states_a = [torch.zeros(self.observations.shape[0], *hid_a[i].shape, device=self.device) for i in range(len(hid_a))]
            self.saved_hidden_states_c = [torch.zeros(self.observations.shape[0], *hid_c[i].shape, device=self.device) for i in range(len(hid_c))]
        # copy the states
        for i in range(len(hid_a)):
            self.saved_hidden_states_a[i][self.step].copy_(hid_a[i])
            self.saved_hidden_states_c[i][self.step].copy_(hid_c[i])


    def clear(self):
        self.step = 0

    def compute_returns(self, last_values, gamma, lam):
        advantage = 0
        for step in reversed(range(self.num_transitions_per_env)):
            if step == self.num_transitions_per_env - 1:
                next_values = last_values
            else:
                next_values = self.values[step + 1]
            next_is_not_terminal = 1.0 - self.dones[step].float()
            delta = self.rewards[step] + next_is_not_terminal * gamma * next_values - self.values[step]
            advantage = delta + next_is_not_terminal * gamma * lam * advantage
            self.returns[step] = advantage + self.values[step]

        # Compute and normalize the advantages
        self.advantages = self.returns - self.values
        self.advantages = (self.advantages - self.advantages.mean()) / (self.advantages.std() + 1e-8)

    def get_statistics(self):
        done = self.dones
        done[-1] = 1
        flat_dones = done.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(-1, 1)
        done_indices = torch.cat((flat_dones.new_tensor([-1], dtype=torch.int64), flat_dones.nonzero(as_tuple=False)[:, 0]))
        trajectory_lengths = (done_indices[1:] - done_indices[:-1])
        return trajectory_lengths.float().mean(), self.rewards.mean()

    def mini_batch_generator(self, num_mini_batches, num_epochs=8):
        batch_size = self.num_envs * self.num_transitions_per_env
        mini_batch_size = batch_size // num_mini_batches
        indices = torch.randperm(num_mini_batches*mini_batch_size, requires_grad=False, device=self.device)

        observations = self.observations.flatten(0, 1)
        if self.privileged_observations is not None:
            critic_observations = self.privileged_observations.flatten(0, 1)
        else:
            critic_observations = observations

        actions = self.actions.flatten(0, 1)
        values = self.values.flatten(0, 1)
        returns = self.returns.flatten(0, 1)
        old_actions_log_prob = self.actions_log_prob.flatten(0, 1)
        advantages = self.advantages.flatten(0, 1)
        old_mu = self.mu.flatten(0, 1)
        old_sigma = self.sigma.flatten(0, 1)

        for epoch in range(num_epochs):
            for i in range(num_mini_batches):

                start = i*mini_batch_size
                end = (i+1)*mini_batch_size
                batch_idx = indices[start:end]

                obs_batch = observations[batch_idx]
                critic_observations_batch = critic_observations[batch_idx]
                actions_batch = actions[batch_idx]
                target_values_batch = values[batch_idx]
                returns_batch = returns[batch_idx]
                old_actions_log_prob_batch = old_actions_log_prob[batch_idx]
                advantages_batch = advantages[batch_idx]
                old_mu_batch = old_mu[batch_idx]
                old_sigma_batch = old_sigma[batch_idx]
                yield obs_batch, critic_observations_batch, actions_batch, target_values_batch, advantages_batch, returns_batch, \
                       old_actions_log_prob_batch, old_mu_batch, old_sigma_batch, (None, None), None

baselines.name: Asymmetric actor-critic (Gu et al., 2024; Pinto et al., 2017)
baselines.docstring:
`default` baseline for robo-humanoid-sim2real-algo: Humanoid-Gym's stock PPO.

Humanoid-Gym (Gu et al., 2024, arXiv:2404.05695) trains an ASYMMETRIC actor-critic:
the policy sees the 15-frame stack of noisy proprioception (705 floats) and the
value function sees a 3-frame stack of noise-free privileged simulator state (219
floats: base linear velocity, push forces, friction, mass, contact/stance masks,
...). PPO is the rsl_rl clipped-surrogate PPO with a learned state-independent
action std.

The three class bodies below are byte-identical to the vendored package's
humanoid/algo/ppo/{actor_critic,ppo,rollout_storage}.py @ ae46e201 (and to the
task template): this arm is the unmodified starting point of the task.

"""`default` baseline for robo-humanoid-sim2real-algo: Humanoid-Gym's stock PPO.

Humanoid-Gym (Gu et al., 2024, arXiv:2404.05695) trains an ASYMMETRIC actor-critic:
the policy sees the 15-frame stack of noisy proprioception (705 floats) and the
value function sees a 3-frame stack of noise-free privileged simulator state (219
floats: base linear velocity, push forces, friction, mass, contact/stance masks,
...). PPO is the rsl_rl clipped-surrogate PPO with a learned state-independent
action std.

The three class bodies below are byte-identical to the vendored package's
humanoid/algo/ppo/{actor_critic,ppo,rollout_storage}.py @ ae46e201 (and to the
task template): this arm is the unmodified starting point of the task.
"""

_ACTOR_CRITIC_FILE = "humanoid-gym/humanoid/algo/ppo/actor_critic_custom.py"
_PPO_FILE = "humanoid-gym/humanoid/algo/ppo/ppo_custom.py"
_ROLLOUT_STORAGE_FILE = "humanoid-gym/humanoid/algo/ppo/rollout_storage_custom.py"

_ACTOR_CRITIC_CONTENT = '''\
class ActorCritic(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self,  num_actor_obs,
                        num_critic_obs,
                        num_actions,
                        actor_hidden_dims=[256, 256, 256],
                        critic_hidden_dims=[256, 256, 256],
                        init_noise_std=1.0,
                        activation = nn.ELU(),
                        **kwargs):
        if kwargs:

class PPO:
    actor_critic: ActorCritic
    def __init__(self,
                 actor_critic,
                 num_learning_epochs=1,
                 num_mini_batches=1,
                 clip_param=0.2,

        self.schedule = schedule
        self.learning_rate = learning_rate

        self.entropy_coef = entropy_coef
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.lam = lam

    def init_storage(self, num_envs, num_transitions_per_env, actor_obs_shape, critic_obs_shape, action_shape):
        self.storage = RolloutStorage(num_envs, num_transitions_per_env, actor_obs_shape, critic_obs_shape, action_shape, self.device)

    def test_mode(self):
        self.actor_critic.eval()

    def train_mode(self):
        self.actor_critic.train()

    def act(self, obs, critic_obs):
        # Compute the actions and values. Both observation views are handed to
        # the actor-critic; the stock ActorCritic ignores the keyword extras.
        self.transition.actions = self.actor_critic.act(obs, critic_obs=critic_obs).detach()
        self.transition.values = self.actor_critic.evaluate(critic_obs, obs=obs).detach()
        self.transition.actions_log_prob = self.actor_critic.get_actions_log_prob(self.transition.actions).detach()
        self.transition.action_mean = self.actor_critic.action_mean.detach()
        self.transition.action_sigma = self.actor_critic.action_std.detach()
        # need to record obs and critic_obs before env.step()
        self.transition.observations = obs
        self.transition.critic_observations = critic_obs
        return self.transition.actions

    def process_env_step(self, rewards, dones, infos):
        self.transition.rewards = rewards.clone()
        self.transition.dones = dones
        # Bootstrapping on time outs
        if 'time_outs' in infos:
            self.transition.rewards += self.gamma * torch.squeeze(self.transition.values * infos['time_outs'].unsqueeze(1).to(self.device), 1)

        self.storage.add_transitions(self.transition)
        self.transition.clear()
        self.actor_critic.reset(dones)

    def compute_returns(self, last_critic_obs, last_obs=None):
        last_values = self.actor_critic.evaluate(last_critic_obs, obs=last_obs).detach()
        self.storage.compute_returns(last_values, self.gamma, self.lam)

    def update(self):
        mean_value_loss = 0
        mean_surrogate_loss = 0

        generator = self.storage.mini_batch_generator(self.num_mini_batches, self.num_learning_epochs)
        for obs_batch, critic_obs_batch, actions_batch, target_values_batch, advantages_batch, returns_batch, old_actions_log_prob_batch, \\
            old_mu_batch, old_sigma_batch, hid_states_batch, masks_batch in generator:


                self.actor_critic.act(obs_batch, critic_obs=critic_obs_batch, masks=masks_batch, hidden_states=hid_states_batch[0])
                actions_log_prob_batch = self.actor_critic.get_actions_log_prob(actions_batch)
                value_batch = self.actor_critic.evaluate(critic_obs_batch, obs=obs_batch, masks=masks_batch, hidden_states=hid_states_batch[1])
                mu_batch = self.actor_critic.action_mean
                sigma_batch = self.actor_critic.action_std
                entropy_batch = self.actor_critic.entropy

                # KL
                if self.desired_kl != None and self.schedule == 'adaptive':
                    with torch.inference_mode():
                        kl = torch.sum(
                            torch.log(sigma_batch / old_sigma_batch + 1.e-5) + (torch.square(old_sigma_batch) + torch.square(old_mu_batch - mu_batch)) / (2.0 * torch.square(sigma_batch)) - 0.5, axis=-1)
                        kl_mean = torch.mean(kl)

                        if kl_mean > self.desired_kl * 2.0:
                            self.learning_rate = max(1e-5, self.learning_rate / 1.5)
                        elif kl_mean < self.desired_kl / 2.0 and kl_mean > 0.0:
                            self.learning_rate = min(1e-2, self.learning_rate * 1.5)

                        for param_group in self.optimizer.param_groups:

                ratio = torch.exp(actions_log_prob_batch - torch.squeeze(old_actions_log_prob_batch))

                surrogate_clipped = -torch.squeeze(advantages_batch) * torch.clamp(ratio, 1.0 - self.clip_param,
                                                                                1.0 + self.clip_param)
                surrogate_loss = torch.max(surrogate, surrogate_clipped).mean()

                # Value function loss
                if self.use_clipped_value_loss:
                    value_clipped = target_values_batch + (value_batch - target_values_batch).clamp(-self.clip_param,
                                                                                                    self.clip_param)
                    value_losses = (value_batch - returns_batch).pow(2)

                else:

                self.optimizer.zero_grad()
                loss.backward()

        mean_value_loss /= num_updates
        mean_surrogate_loss /= num_updates
        self.storage.clear()

        return mean_value_loss, mean_surrogate_loss

_ROLLOUT_STORAGE_CONTENT = '''\
class RolloutStorage:
    class Transition:
        def __init__(self):
            self.observations = None
            self.critic_observations = None
            self.actions = None
            self.rewards = None
            self.dones = None
            self.values = None
            self.actions_log_prob = None
            self.action_mean = None
            self.action_sigma = None
            self.hidden_states = None

        def clear(self):
            self.__init__()

    def __init__(self, num_envs, num_transitions_per_env, obs_shape, privileged_obs_shape, actions_shape, device='cpu'):

        self.device = device

        self.obs_shape = obs_shape
        self.privileged_obs_shape = privileged_obs_shape
        self.actions_shape = actions_shape

        # Core
        self.observations = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, *obs_shape, device=self.device)
        if privileged_obs_shape[0] is not None:
            self.privileged_observations = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, *privileged_obs_shape, device=self.device)
        else:
            self.privileged_observations = None
        self.rewards = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device)
        self.actions = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, *actions_shape, device=self.device)
        self.dones = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device).byte()

        # For PPO
        self.actions_log_prob = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device)
        self.values = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device)
        self.returns = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device)
        self.advantages = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device)
        self.mu = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, *actions_shape, device=self.device)
        self.sigma = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, *actions_shape, device=self.device)

        self.num_transitions_per_env = num_transitions_per_env
        self.num_envs = num_envs

        # rnn
        self.saved_hidden_states_a = None
        self.saved_hidden_states_c = None

        self.step = 0

    def add_transitions(self, transition: Transition):
        if self.step >= self.num_transitions_per_env:
            raise AssertionError("Rollout buffer overflow")
        self.observations[self.step].copy_(transition.observations)
        if self.privileged_observations is not None: self.privileged_observations[self.step].copy_(transition.critic_observations)
        self.actions[self.step].copy_(transition.actions)
        self.rewards[self.step].copy_(transition.rewards.view(-1, 1))
        self.dones[self.step].copy_(transition.dones.view(-1, 1))
        self.values[self.step].copy_(transition.values)
        self.actions_log_prob[self.step].copy_(transition.actions_log_prob.view(-1, 1))
        self.mu[self.step].copy_(transition.action_mean)
        self.sigma[self.step].copy_(transition.action_sigma)
        self._save_hidden_states(transition.hidden_states)
        self.step += 1

    def _save_hidden_states(self, hidden_states):
        if hidden_states is None or hidden_states==(None, None):
            return
        # make a tuple out of GRU hidden state to match the LSTM format
        hid_a = hidden_states[0] if isinstance(hidden_states[0], tuple) else (hidden_states[0],)
        hid_c = hidden_states[1] if isinstance(hidden_states[1], tuple) else (hidden_states[1],)

        # initialize if needed
        if self.saved_hidden_states_a is None:
            self.saved_hidden_states_a = [torch.zeros(self.observations.shape[0], *hid_a[i].shape, device=self.device) for i in range(len(hid_a))]
            self.saved_hidden_states_c = [torch.zeros(self.observations.shape[0], *hid_c[i].shape, device=self.device) for i in range(len(hid_c))]
        # copy the states
        for i in range(len(hid_a)):
            self.saved_hidden_states_a[i][self.step].copy_(hid_a[i])
            self.saved_hidden_states_c[i][self.step].copy_(hid_c[i])


    def clear(self):
        self.step = 0

    def compute_returns(self, last_values, gamma, lam):
        advantage = 0
        for step in reversed(range(self.num_transitions_per_env)):
            if step == self.num_transitions_per_env - 1:
                next_values = last_values
            else:
                next_values = self.values[step + 1]
            next_is_not_terminal = 1.0 - self.dones[step].float()
            delta = self.rewards[step] + next_is_not_terminal * gamma * next_values - self.values[step]
            advantage = delta + next_is_not_terminal * gamma * lam * advantage
            self.returns[step] = advantage + self.values[step]

        # Compute and normalize the advantages
        self.advantages = self.returns - self.values
        self.advantages = (self.advantages - self.advantages.mean()) / (self.advantages.std() + 1e-8)

    def get_statistics(self):
        done = self.dones
        done[-1] = 1
        flat_dones = done.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(-1, 1)
        done_indices = torch.cat((flat_dones.new_tensor([-1], dtype=torch.int64), flat_dones.nonzero(as_tuple=False)[:, 0]))
        trajectory_lengths = (done_indices[1:] - done_indices[:-1])
        return trajectory_lengths.float().mean(), self.rewards.mean()

    def mini_batch_generator(self, num_mini_batches, num_epochs=8):
        batch_size = self.num_envs * self.num_transitions_per_env
        mini_batch_size = batch_size // num_mini_batches
        indices = torch.randperm(num_mini_batches*mini_batch_size, requires_grad=False, device=self.device)

        observations = self.observations.flatten(0, 1)
        if self.privileged_observations is not None:
            critic_observations = self.privileged_observations.flatten(0, 1)
        else:
            critic_observations = observations

        actions = self.actions.flatten(0, 1)
        values = self.values.flatten(0, 1)
        returns = self.returns.flatten(0, 1)
        old_actions_log_prob = self.actions_log_prob.flatten(0, 1)
        advantages = self.advantages.flatten(0, 1)
        old_mu = self.mu.flatten(0, 1)
        old_sigma = self.sigma.flatten(0, 1)

        for epoch in range(num_epochs):
            for i in range(num_mini_batches):

                start = i*mini_batch_size
                end = (i+1)*mini_batch_size
                batch_idx = indices[start:end]

                obs_batch = observations[batch_idx]
                critic_observations_batch = critic_observations[batch_idx]
                actions_batch = actions[batch_idx]
                target_values_batch = values[batch_idx]
                returns_batch = returns[batch_idx]
                old_actions_log_prob_batch = old_actions_log_prob[batch_idx]
                advantages_batch = advantages[batch_idx]
                old_mu_batch = old_mu[batch_idx]
                old_sigma_batch = old_sigma[batch_idx]
                yield obs_batch, critic_observations_batch, actions_batch, target_values_batch, advantages_batch, returns_batch, \\
                       old_actions_log_prob_batch, old_mu_batch, old_sigma_batch, (None, None), None

#               (3), base euler (3), push force xy (2), push torque (3), foot
#               friction (1), body mass/30 (1), stance mask (2), contact mask (2)].
#               Privileged state exists ONLY in simulation: the deployed policy
#               never sees it.
# Deployment contract: `self.actor` is exported by torch.jit.trace on a [1, 705]

class ActorCritic(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self,  num_actor_obs,
                        num_critic_obs,
                        num_actions,

                        critic_hidden_dims=[256, 256, 256],
                        init_noise_std=1.0,
                        activation = nn.ELU(),

            print("ActorCritic.__init__ got unexpected arguments, which will be ignored: " + str([key for key in kwargs.keys()]))

        mlp_input_dim_a = num_actor_obs
        mlp_input_dim_c = num_critic_obs
        # Policy
        actor_layers = []
        actor_layers.append(nn.Linear(mlp_input_dim_a, actor_hidden_dims[0]))
        actor_layers.append(activation)
        for l in range(len(actor_hidden_dims)):

            else:
                actor_layers.append(nn.Linear(actor_hidden_dims[l], actor_hidden_dims[l + 1]))

        # Value function

        critic_layers.append(nn.Linear(mlp_input_dim_c, critic_hidden_dims[0]))
        critic_layers.append(activation)
        for l in range(len(critic_hidden_dims)):
            if l == len(critic_hidden_dims) - 1:
                critic_layers.append(nn.Linear(critic_hidden_dims[l], 1))
            else:
                critic_layers.append(nn.Linear(critic_hidden_dims[l], critic_hidden_dims[l + 1]))
                critic_layers.append(activation)
        self.critic = nn.Sequential(*critic_layers)

        print(f"Actor MLP: {self.actor}")
        print(f"Critic MLP: {self.critic}")

        # Action noise
        self.std = nn.Parameter(init_noise_std * torch.ones(num_actions))
        self.distribution = None
        # disable args validation for speedup
        Normal.set_default_validate_args = False


    @staticmethod
    # not used at the moment
    def init_weights(sequential, scales):
        [torch.nn.init.orthogonal_(module.weight, gain=scales[idx]) for idx, module in
         enumerate(mod for mod in sequential if isinstance(mod, nn.Linear))]


    def reset(self, dones=None):
        pass

    def forward(self):
        raise NotImplementedError

    @property
    def action_mean(self):
        return self.distribution.mean

    @property
    def action_std(self):
        return self.distribution.stddev

    @property
    def entropy(self):
        return self.distribution.entropy().sum(dim=-1)

    def update_distribution(self, observations):
        mean = self.actor(observations)
        self.distribution = Normal(mean, mean*0. + self.std)

    def act(self, observations, **kwargs):
        self.update_distribution(observations)
        return self.distribution.sample()

    def get_actions_log_prob(self, actions):
        return self.distribution.log_prob(actions).sum(dim=-1)

    def act_inference(self, observations):
        actions_mean = self.actor(observations)
        return actions_mean

    def evaluate(self, critic_observations, **kwargs):

        return value

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim

from .actor_critic_custom import ActorCritic
from .rollout_storage_custom import RolloutStorage

# Harness contract (OnPolicyRunner, read-only). Per iteration it calls
#   act(obs, critic_obs)                       once per env step (no grad)
#   process_env_step(rewards, dones, infos)    after every env step
#   compute_returns(last_critic_obs, last_obs) once, after the rollout
#   update() -> (mean_value_loss, mean_surrogate_loss)
# and it sets self.num_learning_iterations (the total iteration budget) before
# the first iteration. It reads self.actor_critic.std, self.learning_rate and
# self.optimizer (checkpoints). Rollouts continue across iterations without an
# environment reset, so the `obs` of the first act() of iteration i+1 is the
# successor of the last transition of iteration i.

class PPO:
    actor_critic: ActorCritic
    def __init__(self,
                 actor_critic,
                 num_learning_epochs=1,
                 num_mini_batches=1,
                 clip_param=0.2,
                 gamma=0.998,
                 lam=0.95,
                 value_loss_coef=1.0,
                 entropy_coef=0.0,
                 learning_rate=1e-3,
                 max_grad_norm=1.0,
                 use_clipped_value_loss=True,
                 schedule="fixed",
                 desired_kl=0.01,
                 device='cpu',
                 ):

        self.device = device

        self.desired_kl = desired_kl
        self.schedule = schedule
        self.learning_rate = learning_rate

        # PPO components
        self.actor_critic = actor_critic
        self.actor_critic.to(self.device)
        self.storage = None # initialized later
        self.optimizer = optim.Adam(self.actor_critic.parameters(), lr=learning_rate)
        self.transition = RolloutStorage.Transition()

        # PPO parameters
        self.clip_param = clip_param
        self.num_learning_epochs = num_learning_epochs
        self.num_mini_batches = num_mini_batches
        self.value_loss_coef = value_loss_coef
        self.entropy_coef = entropy_coef
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.lam = lam
        self.max_grad_norm = max_grad_norm
        self.use_clipped_value_loss = use_clipped_value_loss

    def init_storage(self, num_envs, num_transitions_per_env, actor_obs_shape, critic_obs_shape, action_shape):
        self.storage = RolloutStorage(num_envs, num_transitions_per_env, actor_obs_shape, critic_obs_shape, action_shape, self.device)

    def test_mode(self):
        self.actor_critic.eval()

    def train_mode(self):
        self.actor_critic.train()

    def act(self, obs, critic_obs):
        # Compute the actions and values. Both observation views are handed to
        # the actor-critic; the stock ActorCritic ignores the keyword extras.
        self.transition.actions = self.actor_critic.act(obs, critic_obs=critic_obs).detach()
        self.transition.values = self.actor_critic.evaluate(critic_obs, obs=obs).detach()
        self.transition.actions_log_prob = self.actor_critic.get_actions_log_prob(self.transition.actions).detach()
        self.transition.action_mean = self.actor_critic.action_mean.detach()
        self.transition.action_sigma = self.actor_critic.action_std.detach()
        # need to record obs and critic_obs before env.step()
        self.transition.observations = obs
        self.transition.critic_observations = critic_obs
        return self.transition.actions

    def process_env_step(self, rewards, dones, infos):
        self.transition.rewards = rewards.clone()
        self.transition.dones = dones
        # Bootstrapping on time outs
        if 'time_outs' in infos:
            self.transition.rewards += self.gamma * torch.squeeze(self.transition.values * infos['time_outs'].unsqueeze(1).to(self.device), 1)

        # Record the transition
        self.storage.add_transitions(self.transition)
        self.transition.clear()
        self.actor_critic.reset(dones)

    def compute_returns(self, last_critic_obs, last_obs=None):
        last_values = self.actor_critic.evaluate(last_critic_obs, obs=last_obs).detach()
        self.storage.compute_returns(last_values, self.gamma, self.lam)

    def update(self):
        mean_value_loss = 0
        mean_surrogate_loss = 0

        generator = self.storage.mini_batch_generator(self.num_mini_batches, self.num_learning_epochs)
        for obs_batch, critic_obs_batch, actions_batch, target_values_batch, advantages_batch, returns_batch, old_actions_log_prob_batch, \
            old_mu_batch, old_sigma_batch, hid_states_batch, masks_batch in generator:


                self.actor_critic.act(obs_batch, critic_obs=critic_obs_batch, masks=masks_batch, hidden_states=hid_states_batch[0])
                actions_log_prob_batch = self.actor_critic.get_actions_log_prob(actions_batch)
                value_batch = self.actor_critic.evaluate(critic_obs_batch, obs=obs_batch, masks=masks_batch, hidden_states=hid_states_batch[1])
                mu_batch = self.actor_critic.action_mean
                sigma_batch = self.actor_critic.action_std
                entropy_batch = self.actor_critic.entropy

                # KL
                if self.desired_kl != None and self.schedule == 'adaptive':
                    with torch.inference_mode():
                        kl = torch.sum(
                            torch.log(sigma_batch / old_sigma_batch + 1.e-5) + (torch.square(old_sigma_batch) + torch.square(old_mu_batch - mu_batch)) / (2.0 * torch.square(sigma_batch)) - 0.5, axis=-1)
                        kl_mean = torch.mean(kl)

                        if kl_mean > self.desired_kl * 2.0:
                            self.learning_rate = max(1e-5, self.learning_rate / 1.5)
                        elif kl_mean < self.desired_kl / 2.0 and kl_mean > 0.0:
                            self.learning_rate = min(1e-2, self.learning_rate * 1.5)

                        for param_group in self.optimizer.param_groups:
                            param_group['lr'] = self.learning_rate


                # Surrogate loss
                ratio = torch.exp(actions_log_prob_batch - torch.squeeze(old_actions_log_prob_batch))
                surrogate = -torch.squeeze(advantages_batch) * ratio
                surrogate_clipped = -torch.squeeze(advantages_batch) * torch.clamp(ratio, 1.0 - self.clip_param,
                                                                                1.0 + self.clip_param)
                surrogate_loss = torch.max(surrogate, surrogate_clipped).mean()

                # Value function loss
                if self.use_clipped_value_loss:
                    value_clipped = target_values_batch + (value_batch - target_values_batch).clamp(-self.clip_param,
                                                                                                    self.clip_param)
                    value_losses = (value_batch - returns_batch).pow(2)
                    value_losses_clipped = (value_clipped - returns_batch).pow(2)
                    value_loss = torch.max(value_losses, value_losses_clipped).mean()
                else:
                    value_loss = (returns_batch - value_batch).pow(2).mean()

                loss = surrogate_loss + self.value_loss_coef * value_loss - self.entropy_coef * entropy_batch.mean()

                # Gradient step
                self.optimizer.zero_grad()
                loss.backward()
                nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(self.actor_critic.parameters(), self.max_grad_norm)
                self.optimizer.step()

                mean_value_loss += value_loss.item()
                mean_surrogate_loss += surrogate_loss.item()

        num_updates = self.num_learning_epochs * self.num_mini_batches
        mean_value_loss /= num_updates
        mean_surrogate_loss /= num_updates
        self.storage.clear()

        return mean_value_loss, mean_surrogate_loss

import torch

class RolloutStorage:
    class Transition:
        def __init__(self):
            self.observations = None
            self.critic_observations = None
            self.actions = None
            self.rewards = None
            self.dones = None
            self.values = None
            self.actions_log_prob = None
            self.action_mean = None
            self.action_sigma = None
            self.hidden_states = None

        def clear(self):
            self.__init__()

    def __init__(self, num_envs, num_transitions_per_env, obs_shape, privileged_obs_shape, actions_shape, device='cpu'):

        self.device = device

        self.obs_shape = obs_shape
        self.privileged_obs_shape = privileged_obs_shape
        self.actions_shape = actions_shape

        # Core
        self.observations = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, *obs_shape, device=self.device)
        if privileged_obs_shape[0] is not None:
            self.privileged_observations = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, *privileged_obs_shape, device=self.device)
        else:
            self.privileged_observations = None
        self.rewards = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device)
        self.actions = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, *actions_shape, device=self.device)
        self.dones = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device).byte()

        # For PPO
        self.actions_log_prob = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device)
        self.values = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device)
        self.returns = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device)
        self.advantages = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, 1, device=self.device)
        self.mu = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, *actions_shape, device=self.device)
        self.sigma = torch.zeros(num_transitions_per_env, num_envs, *actions_shape, device=self.device)

        self.num_transitions_per_env = num_transitions_per_env
        self.num_envs = num_envs

        # rnn
        self.saved_hidden_states_a = None
        self.saved_hidden_states_c = None

        self.step = 0

    def add_transitions(self, transition: Transition):
        if self.step >= self.num_transitions_per_env:
            raise AssertionError("Rollout buffer overflow")
        self.observations[self.step].copy_(transition.observations)
        if self.privileged_observations is not None: self.privileged_observations[self.step].copy_(transition.critic_observations)
        self.actions[self.step].copy_(transition.actions)
        self.rewards[self.step].copy_(transition.rewards.view(-1, 1))
        self.dones[self.step].copy_(transition.dones.view(-1, 1))
        self.values[self.step].copy_(transition.values)
        self.actions_log_prob[self.step].copy_(transition.actions_log_prob.view(-1, 1))
        self.mu[self.step].copy_(transition.action_mean)
        self.sigma[self.step].copy_(transition.action_sigma)
        self._save_hidden_states(transition.hidden_states)
        self.step += 1

    def _save_hidden_states(self, hidden_states):
        if hidden_states is None or hidden_states==(None, None):
            return
        # make a tuple out of GRU hidden state to match the LSTM format
        hid_a = hidden_states[0] if isinstance(hidden_states[0], tuple) else (hidden_states[0],)
        hid_c = hidden_states[1] if isinstance(hidden_states[1], tuple) else (hidden_states[1],)

        # initialize if needed
        if self.saved_hidden_states_a is None:
            self.saved_hidden_states_a = [torch.zeros(self.observations.shape[0], *hid_a[i].shape, device=self.device) for i in range(len(hid_a))]
            self.saved_hidden_states_c = [torch.zeros(self.observations.shape[0], *hid_c[i].shape, device=self.device) for i in range(len(hid_c))]
        # copy the states
        for i in range(len(hid_a)):
            self.saved_hidden_states_a[i][self.step].copy_(hid_a[i])
            self.saved_hidden_states_c[i][self.step].copy_(hid_c[i])


    def clear(self):
        self.step = 0

    def compute_returns(self, last_values, gamma, lam):
        advantage = 0
        for step in reversed(range(self.num_transitions_per_env)):
            if step == self.num_transitions_per_env - 1:
                next_values = last_values
            else:
                next_values = self.values[step + 1]
            next_is_not_terminal = 1.0 - self.dones[step].float()
            delta = self.rewards[step] + next_is_not_terminal * gamma * next_values - self.values[step]
            advantage = delta + next_is_not_terminal * gamma * lam * advantage
            self.returns[step] = advantage + self.values[step]

        # Compute and normalize the advantages
        self.advantages = self.returns - self.values
        self.advantages = (self.advantages - self.advantages.mean()) / (self.advantages.std() + 1e-8)

    def get_statistics(self):
        done = self.dones
        done[-1] = 1
        flat_dones = done.permute(1, 0, 2).reshape(-1, 1)
        done_indices = torch.cat((flat_dones.new_tensor([-1], dtype=torch.int64), flat_dones.nonzero(as_tuple=False)[:, 0]))
        trajectory_lengths = (done_indices[1:] - done_indices[:-1])
        return trajectory_lengths.float().mean(), self.rewards.mean()

    def mini_batch_generator(self, num_mini_batches, num_epochs=8):
        batch_size = self.num_envs * self.num_transitions_per_env
        mini_batch_size = batch_size // num_mini_batches
        indices = torch.randperm(num_mini_batches*mini_batch_size, requires_grad=False, device=self.device)

        observations = self.observations.flatten(0, 1)
        if self.privileged_observations is not None:
            critic_observations = self.privileged_observations.flatten(0, 1)
        else:
            critic_observations = observations

        actions = self.actions.flatten(0, 1)
        values = self.values.flatten(0, 1)
        returns = self.returns.flatten(0, 1)
        old_actions_log_prob = self.actions_log_prob.flatten(0, 1)
        advantages = self.advantages.flatten(0, 1)
        old_mu = self.mu.flatten(0, 1)
        old_sigma = self.sigma.flatten(0, 1)

        for epoch in range(num_epochs):
            for i in range(num_mini_batches):

                start = i*mini_batch_size
                end = (i+1)*mini_batch_size
                batch_idx = indices[start:end]

                obs_batch = observations[batch_idx]
                critic_observations_batch = critic_observations[batch_idx]
                actions_batch = actions[batch_idx]
                target_values_batch = values[batch_idx]
                returns_batch = returns[batch_idx]
                old_actions_log_prob_batch = old_actions_log_prob[batch_idx]
                advantages_batch = advantages[batch_idx]
                old_mu_batch = old_mu[batch_idx]
                old_sigma_batch = old_sigma[batch_idx]
                yield obs_batch, critic_observations_batch, actions_batch, target_values_batch, advantages_batch, returns_batch, \
                       old_actions_log_prob_batch, old_mu_batch, old_sigma_batch, (None, None), None

baselines.name: Symmetric critic (Pinto et al., 2017, ablation)
baselines.docstring:
`symmetric_critic` baseline: the critic sees only what the policy sees.

Pinto et al. (2017, arXiv:1710.06542) introduce the asymmetric actor-critic --
critic on the full simulator state, actor on partial observations -- and compare
it against the SYMMETRIC actor-critic, where both networks get the same partial
observation. Humanoid-Gym's stock PPO (`default`) is the asymmetric variant
(privileged 219-float critic input); this arm is the symmetric control: the value
function is conditioned on the same 705-float frame-stacked noisy proprioception
the policy receives and never sees privileged simulator state. It is what rsl_rl's
OnPolicyRunner does when `num_privileged_obs is None` (critic_obs := obs).

Reference (port): leggedrobotics/rsl_rl OnPolicyRunner -- `num_critic_obs =
self.env.num_obs` when no privileged observations are provided; the vendored
humanoid-gym runner (on_policy_runner.py:62-65) carries the same branch. The only
change to the stock class body is the critic input dimension and `evaluate()`
reading the actor observation that the harness hands it (`obs=` keyword).
PPO and rollout storage: stock (template).

Pinto et al. (2017, arXiv:1710.06542) introduce the asymmetric actor-critic --
critic on the full simulator state, actor on partial observations -- and compare

Reference (port): leggedrobotics/rsl_rl OnPolicyRunner -- `num_critic_obs =
self.env.num_obs` when no privileged observations are provided; the vendored
humanoid-gym runner (on_policy_runner.py:62-65) carries the same branch. The only
change to the stock class body is the critic input dimension and `evaluate()`
reading the actor observation that the harness hands it (`obs=` keyword).
PPO and rollout storage: stock (template).
"""

_ACTOR_CRITIC_FILE = "humanoid-gym/humanoid/algo/ppo/actor_critic_custom.py"

_ACTOR_CRITIC_CONTENT = '''\
class ActorCritic(nn.Module):
    """Symmetric actor-critic: value function on the policy's own observation."""

    def __init__(self,  num_actor_obs,
                        num_critic_obs,
                        num_actions,
                        actor_hidden_dims=[256, 256, 256],
                        critic_hidden_dims=[256, 256, 256],
                        init_noise_std=1.0,
                        activation = nn.ELU(),
                        **kwargs):
        if kwargs:
            print("ActorCritic.__init__ got unexpected arguments, which will be ignored: " + str([key for key in kwargs.keys()]))
        super(ActorCritic, self).__init__()


        mlp_input_dim_a = num_actor_obs
        # SYMMETRIC: the critic consumes the actor observation, not the privileged
        # state. num_critic_obs (219) is accepted for the harness contract and ignored.
        mlp_input_dim_c = num_actor_obs
        # Policy
        actor_layers = []
        actor_layers.append(nn.Linear(mlp_input_dim_a, actor_hidden_dims[0]))
        actor_layers.append(activation)
        for l in range(len(actor_hidden_dims)):
            if l == len(actor_hidden_dims) - 1:
                actor_layers.append(nn.Linear(actor_hidden_dims[l], num_actions))
            else:
                actor_layers.append(nn.Linear(actor_hidden_dims[l], actor_hidden_dims[l + 1]))
                actor_layers.append(activation)
        self.actor = nn.Sequential(*actor_layers)

        # Value function
        critic_layers = []
        critic_layers.append(nn.Linear(mlp_input_dim_c, critic_hidden_dims[0]))
        critic_layers.append(activation)
        for l in range(len(critic_hidden_dims)):
            if l == len(critic_hidden_dims) - 1:
                critic_layers.append(nn.Linear(critic_hidden_dims[l], 1))
            else:
                critic_layers.append(nn.Linear(critic_hidden_dims[l], critic_hidden_dims[l + 1]))
                critic_layers.append(activation)
        self.critic = nn.Sequential(*critic_layers)

        print(f"Actor MLP: {self.actor}")
        print(f"Critic MLP (symmetric, on actor obs): {self.critic}")

        # Action noise
        self.std = nn.Parameter(init_noise_std * torch.ones(num_actions))
        self.distribution = None
        # disable args validation for speedup
        Normal.set_default_validate_args = False


    @staticmethod
    # not used at the moment
    def init_weights(sequential, scales):
        [torch.nn.init.orthogonal_(module.weight, gain=scales[idx]) for idx, module in
         enumerate(mod for mod in sequential if isinstance(mod, nn.Linear))]


    def reset(self, dones=None):
        pass

    def forward(self):
        raise NotImplementedError

    @property
    def action_mean(self):
        return self.distribution.mean

    @property
    def action_std(self):
        return self.distribution.stddev

    @property
    def entropy(self):
        return self.distribution.entropy().sum(dim=-1)

    def update_distribution(self, observations):
        mean = self.actor(observations)
        self.distribution = Normal(mean, mean*0. + self.std)

    def act(self, observations, **kwargs):
        self.update_distribution(observations)
        return self.distribution.sample()

    def get_actions_log_prob(self, actions):
        return self.distribution.log_prob(actions).sum(dim=-1)

    def act_inference(self, observations):
        actions_mean = self.actor(observations)
        return actions_mean

    def evaluate(self, critic_observations, obs=None, **kwargs):
        # The privileged `critic_observations` are deliberately unused: the value
        # function is conditioned on the policy's own (noisy, proprioceptive)
        # observation, which the harness passes as `obs=`.
        if obs is None:
            raise ValueError("symmetric critic: evaluate() needs the actor observation (obs=...)")
        value = self.critic(obs)
        return value
'''
